description: This file defines the interface ByPreMadeFilterInterpreter within the SuiteCRM JSON API filter interfaces namespace. It declares methods for checking the existence of a pre-made filter by name and retrieving the current filter.

classes.name: ByPreMadeFilterInterpreter
classes.description: Interface that requires implementing classes to check for and retrieve predefined filters.

methods.name: hasByPreMadeFilter
methods.description: Checks if a pre-made filter exists by its name.

methods.name: getByPreMadeFilter
methods.description: Retrieves the current pre-made filter as a string.
